description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller 'RelatedItemsController' responsible for managing related product items within the admin interface of an e-commerce application. It includes methods for displaying related items, pagination, adding, and removing related product relationships, with role-based access control.

classes.name: RelatedItemsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling related product items in admin product management.

methods.name: displayRelatedItems
methods.description: Renders the related items management page for a specific product, validating the product belongs to the current merchant.

methods.name: pageRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to retrieve related products in a paginated format, returning JSON data.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST request to add a related product relationship between two products.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST request to remove a related product relationship.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Internal method to set the active menu structure for the view.
